runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Real 14.9.2026 08:58 sweep across Profesia/Práca za rohom, direct company careers, IKEA careers, Worki, Kariera/Zoznam, LinkedIn public indexing and Bratislava local mirrors. One new candidate cleared the full promotion gate: IKEA Bratislava customer relations (official active detail, no foreign-language hard gate, strong complaints/customer-service fit). PSS Call centrum and SUPTel dispatch administration were re-opened and confirmed active. Brightpick Remote technik was explicitly found inactive on Kariera despite fresh resurfacing on other mirrors and remains fail-closed. ÚNMS network specialist was rejected for intermediate English and scope mismatch; IKEA Picker was rejected for physical burden.

developmentChanges.title: Stable source-job IDs for IKEA and Nalgoo ATS
developmentChanges.reason: Multilingual IKEA URLs and alternate Nalgoo/company URLs can represent the same vacancy. Stable source keys now deduplicate those variants before fuzzy company/title matching.

developmentChanges.title: Future publication timestamp quarantine
developmentChanges.reason: A job with a publication timestamp materially in the future is now fail-closed instead of being allowed to influence freshness or ranking.

developmentChanges.title: Verification vs link-evidence drift gate
developmentChanges.reason: Promotion-grade records are quarantined when verifiedAt is advanced more than 60 minutes beyond the last real link check, preventing freshness from being fabricated by touching only the verification timestamp.

developmentChanges.title: Evidence-surface health diagnostics
developmentChanges.reason: Feed health now reports whether eligible jobs come from canonical company details, full job-board details or unspecified evidence, making source quality measurable.
